name: Draw Grid
description: Draws a grid of colored lines on the picture.

params.name: x
params.description: Horizontal offset of the grid, in pixels

params.name: y
params.description: Vertical offset of the grid, in pixels

params.name: width
params.description: Width of a cell in pixels; 0 = the width of the picture

params.name: height
params.description: Height of a cell in pixels; 0 = the height of the picture

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the lines; alpha is its opacity

params.name: thickness
params.description: Thickness of the lines in pixels

params.name: replace
params.description: Replace the color and alpha of the pixels instead of blending

params.name: invert
params.description: Invert the color of the pixels on the lines instead of drawing `color` (FFmpeg: color `invert`)
